problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Strict separation of N = samples + 1 signed feature vectors by the bilinear margin m_i(c,v) = c₁⟨D_i,v⟩ + c₂⟨shift D_i,v⟩. The constraints are nonconvex in the joint parameters (c,v); no optimization objective is specified.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query (i,θ) returns the exact gradient of the individual bilinear margin with respect to θ. Replies are independent of history and oracle seed; there is no oracle error.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: The same component query also returns the exact scalar margin m_i(θ), with value and gradient counted as one oracle call.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Features lie in Euclidean ℝ^d, d > 0; parameters lie in ℝ² × ℝ^d. The shift is a cyclic coordinate permutation.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Write g = lower, R = upper, μ = contrast, κ = margin. Hidden data satisfy D_i = b_i a + μu_i, a = ones/√d, g ≤ |b_i| ≤ R, ⟨a,u_i⟩ = 0, and ‖u_i‖ ≤ 1/√2. A hidden unit vector s satisfies ⟨(u_i − shift u_i)/√2,s⟩ ≥ κ for every i. Background signs may differ. All six Params fields are public. Validity requires 0 < g ≤ R, μ > 0, κ > 0 and κμB ≤ 3R/2, where B = ⌈2²⁴(R/g)²(1 + log(1 + g/μ))/κ³⌉. Allowed algorithms start at ((1,0),0), query components cyclically, and use a fixed positive step size, updating only when the queried margin is nonpositive.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/TwoSidedConvolutionalPerceptron.lean: Geometry, derivative, Params, family, spec.publicInput, spec.valid; LongTails/Setups/ManySampleConvolutionalPerceptron.lean: axis.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The final output must satisfy m_i(θ) > 0 for every sample. There is no epsilon tolerance, normalized output-margin requirement, or objective-gap criterion.

accuracy.label: deterministic
accuracy.details: Success is required for every seed outcome, not merely almost surely or in expectation. The supplied budget is the fixed total N B component-oracle calls, including queries that cause no update.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/TwoSidedConvolutionalPerceptron.lean: spec.successful, family; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace, Convergence; supplied extracted result budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: This separation problem combines signed constant backgrounds, centered defects with a common discrete-derivative separator, a contrast-dependent validity regime, and a prescribed cyclic bilinear update family.
